literal: Ancient lineage and dignity will destroy completely, the craving called poverty.
translation: The craving called poverty will completely destroy both one's ancient lineage and dignity.
modern: வறுமை என்று சொல்லப்படும் பேராசை, ஒருவருடைய பழமையான குடிப்பெருமையையும் அவரது நற்பண்புகளையும் ஒருசேர அழித்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the destructive nature of poverty by describing it as a 'craving' (நசை), because extreme want forces a person to beg and desire things constantly. This desperate state of poverty completely (தொகையாக) ruins two of a person's most valuable possessions: their ancient family lineage (தொல்வரவு) and their personal dignity or lustre (தோல்). The word 'தோல்' here refers to the natural dignity, beauty, or self-respect of an individual, which is lost when one is reduced to begging. The term 'தொகையாக' emphasizes that these noble qualities are not lost gradually, but are wiped out all at once by the onset of poverty.
